inputs.text: A natural editorial portrait photograph of a fictional 26-year-old Chinese woman, chest-up, looking gently toward the camera. Shoulder-length straight black hair tucked behind her ears, small gold stud earrings, an ivory silk blouse under a charcoal gray blazer, no glasses or eyewear. Realistic skin texture and subtle everyday makeup, relaxed closed-mouth smile. She is standing near a large window in a quiet florist studio, with a warm off-white wall and softly blurred green plants behind her. Soft diffused morning side light, believable facial proportions, 85mm portrait lens, restrained neutral colors, elegant and candid rather than airbrushed. Vertical composition, both shoulders visible, clear unobstructed face. No writing, logos or watermarks.
